text:
anna: heads-up: eu-dedicated canary p95 jumped ~180ms, deploy-bot alerted.

deploy-bot: alert: canary.p95=680ms (+180ms) over 5m; error_rate +1.4%. Suggested: PAUSE rollout. auto-rollback disabled for change-window.

mike: Which change went out in this batch? We had a runtime micro-optim and a config tweak.

sylvia: runtime micro-opt (kernel selector) + small trace agent bump. Local perf OK.

ops_oncall: With auto-rollback off we need to choose manual mitigation: full rollback, traffic slice, or targeted revert. Recommend traffic slice 70/30 rollback to previous stable to limit customer impact.

anna: Agreed. Keep canary pinned and run a focused log grep for `cuda_sync_timeout` or `kv_cache_miss`.

deploy-bot: CLI examples:
`redwood traffic set --pool eu-dedicated --split 70:30 --to v2.3.8,v2.4.2`
`redwood pin --instance canary-eu --version v2.4.2`

mike: I'll apply the split and tail errors across versions.

mike: applied. rollout id r-617777-01. monitor: https://telemetry.redwood/prod/eu-dedicated/r-617777-01

10m: mike: overall p95 down to 510ms; v2.3.8 ~495ms; v2.4.2 ~680ms. errors concentrated on v2.4.2.

sylvia: opening cherry-pick revert PR for kernel selector (will run canary e2e on merge).

anna: Notify CS and SRE rotations: `@cs-eu` `@sre-oncall`  short note and monitor link. Draft sent.

ops_oncall: Keep 70/30 split for 30m. If revert fixes canary, re-roll remaining traffic. If not, escalate to full rollback.

sylvia: PR: https://github.com/redwood/release/pull/4477. CI queued.

deploy-bot: canary redeploy gated on CI + prometheus health checks. auto-rollback remains suppressed.

mike: +30m: p95 stable ~490ms. v2.4.2 tail reduced after canary restart; keeping split until PR validated.

anna: closing active thread; reopen if metrics regress. :thumbsup:
